title: TRIO: Task Refinement with Individual Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which leverages external knowledge to improve the performance of language models. Despite the remarkable progress, current RAG approaches are still far from satisfactory due to inadequate retrieval and potential hallucinations. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Task Refinement with Individual Optimization (TRIO) for RAG. The core idea of our TRIO is to equip three well-designed agents with an iterative refinement paradigm by aligning their individual optimization objectives. Specifically, we first expand ambiguous queries with a query extension agent and quantify the reward based on the improved answer quality, which can be utilized to refine our agent for higher expansion efficiency. To enhance the retrieval quality, we include a unanimity voting to annotate the expanded query as insufficient or sufficient, and their generative outcomes are utilized as ground tru

translated_title: TRIO：面向检索增强生成的基于个体优化的任务细化
translated_abstract: 本文研究了检索增强生成，其利用外部知识来提升语言模型的性能。尽管已取得显著进展，但由于检索不充分和潜在的幻觉问题，当前的RAG方法仍远不尽如人意。为此，我们提出了一种名为“基于个体优化的任务细化”（TRIO）的新型RAG方法。TRIO的核心思想是通过协调三个精心设计的智能体的各自优化目标，为它们构建迭代细化范式。具体而言，我们首先利用查询扩展智能体对模糊查询进行扩展，并根据答案质量的提升来量化奖励，该奖励可用于优化智能体以获得更高的扩展效率。为提升检索质量，我们引入一致性投票机制，将扩展后的查询标注为“不充分”或“充分”，并将相应的生成结果用作真值（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出TRIO方法，通过对齐三个智能体的个体优化目标并采用迭代细化范式，解决了检索增强生成中检索不充分和幻觉的问题。
